content.text:
The page matches the approved baselines again. Both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass, with no baseline changes or approvals needed.

Two values in `site/css/styles.css` had drifted from Bootstrap's defaults:
- **`small, .small` font-size:** it was `0.438em` and is back to `0.875em`. This made the "SKU: BST-498" line tiny, which pulled the heading and everything below it up by 5px on desktop and 10px on phone.
- **`.dropdown-toggle::after` margin-left:** it was `0.383em` and is back to `0.255em`. This had widened the "Shop" dropdown caret by 2px in the navbar.

There was only one commit in the repo, so I found these by comparing the style changes against the baselines and Bootstrap 5.2.3's values. I didn't have a record of what the last change was.

STATUS: DONE
